subtitle: Amapuzzle amachashaza
short_description: Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ngo-1 kuya ku-4, uqondiswe amachashaza amhlophe namnyama.
description:
Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ngamadijithi angu-1 kuya ku-4 ukuze idijithi ngayinye ivele kanye emugqeni ngamunye nakukholomu ngayinye. Ushashaza omhlophe phakathi kwamaseli amabili usho ukuthi amadijithi alandelanayo; ushashaza omnyama usho ukuthi enye iphindwe kabili yenye. Imiphetho engenashashaza ayinalutho lwesiqondiso.

Thepha isikwele esivulekile bese uthepha idijithi kuphedi enkulu yamadijithi amane. Izilebhuli ezingaphakathi kwamasikwele nesihloli zikusiza ufunde ngalinye ishashaza.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
